text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan
(Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-Pesalah
1954) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 September 2012.

Pemerluasan dan ubah suaian Akta ke Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan

2. (1) Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-Pesalah 1954 (Akira 467), yang disebut
"Akta yang diperluas" dalam Perintah ini, diperluas ke Wilayah Persekutuan
Labuan.

(2) Dalam pemakaiannya bagi Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan, Akta yang
diperluas diubah suai mengikut cara yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

(Subperenggan 2(2)]

Peruntukan Akta Kehadiran Wajib Pesalah-                   Ubah suaian
Pesalah 1954

Seksyen 3                          Gantikan perkataan "States of Peninsular
Malaysia" dengan perkataan "States of
Peninsular Malaysia and the Federal Territory
of Labuan".

Dibuat 27 Ogos 2012
[KDN.PDP(S) 03/22/3 Hd.2; PN(PU?)415/XIV)

Dengan Titah Perintah,

Dato' Serr Dr. Ali HAMSA

CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) (No. 2) ACT 1984

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF Labuan (EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF THE
OFFENDERS COMPULSORY ATTENDANCE ACT 1954) Orngr 2012

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 7 of the Constitution (Amendment)
(No, 2) Act 1984 [Act A585], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following
order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Territory of Labuan (Extension
and Modification of the Offenders Compulsory Attendance Act 1954)
Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 16 September 2012.
Extension and modification of the Act to the Federal Territory of Labuan

2. (1) The Offenders Compulsory Attendance Act 1954 [Act 46/], which is
referred to as the "extended Act" in this Order, is extended to the Federal
Territory of Labuan.     |

(2) In its application to the Federal Territory of Labuan, the extended Act
is modified in the manner as set out in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

(Subparagraph 2(2))

Provisions of the Offenders Compulsory                      Modification
Attendance Act 1954

Section 3                                         Substitute for the words "States of Peninsular
Malaysia" the words "States of Peninsular
Malaysia and the Federal Territory of
Labuan",

Made 27 August 2012
[KDN.PDP(S) 03/22/3 Jld.2; PN(PU%)415/XTV]

By Command,

Dato' Sri Dr. Att Hamsa
